rich_narrative.summary: SADAGAAT-USA is a humanitarian organization that provides critical aid to underserved communities, primarily in Sudan. Founded in 2002, the charity has grown into a significant relief provider, managing <cite id="3">$1,294,453 in total revenue in FY2023</cite>. The organization maintains a <cite id="1">97.5/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>, which places it among the top-rated nonprofits in its sector. Its operations focus on four primary pillars: water, feeding, health, and education. In FY2024, the charity demonstrated exceptional financial discipline, reporting a <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 98.4%</cite>. This means every dollar of public support was directed toward its core humanitarian missions. The organization is <cite id="2">explicitly zakat-eligible</cite>, serving the categories of the poor (fuqara) and needy (masakin). While its financial efficiency is nearly unmatched, the charity operates with a high-touch direct service model. This results in an average <cite id="1">cost per beneficiary of $2,064.84</cite>, reflecting intensive intervention rather than broad, shallow reach. With a <cite id="3">3-year revenue growth rate of 67.1%</cite>, SADAGAAT-USA is rapidly expanding its capacity to address the ongoing humanitarian crises in its target regions.
